Senior Backend Engineer
Acme Freight is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to scale our logistics platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and operate high-throughput services in Python
- Own CI/CD and observability for the platform team

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience
- Strong Python and FastAPI experience
- Production experience with Kubernetes and AWS
- PostgreSQL performance tuning

Nice to have:
- Terraform or other infrastructure as code
- Kafka
- Mentoring experience

Must be authorized to work in the United States.
